title: David R NDE 3212
content: Had been in hospital a couple of weeks with pneumonia. Late one evening, my parents were visiting. A doctor was present. I felt tired and drifted off. I heard the doctor say, 'He's gone'. Then I was aware that I was floating above the bed at ceiling level. My first response was to wonder why my mother was crying because I felt very serene and peaceful. It did not occur to me that my position above the bed was unusual. I observed the doctor inject something into my left arm and I awoke the next morning. The experience was a short one and I saw no lights or other entities but it was not a dream.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) . Seriously ill with pneumonia.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness Throughout - experience did not seem to last more than a few seconds.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Throughout - experience did not seem to last more than a few seconds.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Moderate do not like/understand the 3 categories. I was a 7th grade student a Roman Catholic School
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist no church goer but with strong religious beliefs
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Immediately after the event and then not for several years. Disbelief.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. I am convinced that it was not drug induced or a dream.
